instances.condition: stub_claude_roundtrip explicitly says NOT a Claude Code invocation but emits observed_downstream_change TRUE
instances.required_interpretation: PACKET_BINDING_ONLY; observed downstream causal change UNKNOWN

instances.condition: synthetic_fixture_return emits observed_downstream_change TRUE and downstream hash changes when payload changes

problem_observed.existing_credit_boundary: Both fixtures already keep Claude runtime and Global J-Space causal runtime credit at zero; this gate prevents their local TRUE labels from being reused as stronger evidence.

admission_law.packet_presence: May establish reentry packet identity/provenance only.
admission_law.synthetic_or_stubbed: Must normalize observed_downstream_change to UNKNOWN and causal_credit to 0.
admission_law.unmeasured_real_interface: Must normalize TRUE/FALSE self-claims to UNKNOWN and causal_credit to 0.
admission_law.measured_observable_interface: TRUE/FALSE may be retained only with an exact matched measurement binding source_result_id, causal_event_id, reentry_digest, intervention, matched control, metric, baseline/intervention values, off-target result and observation surface.
admission_law.global_jspace: Observable workspace reentry evidence cannot by itself grant model-internal or Global J-Space causal credit.

credit_scopes.OBSERVABLE_WORKSPACE_REENTRY_ONLY: bounded interface-level causal evidence only; not Global J-Space/model-internal credit

falsifiers: A stubbed or synthetic source retains observed_downstream_change TRUE after normalization.
An unmeasured reentry retains TRUE/FALSE causal credit.
A measurement without matched_control_id is accepted.
Observable reentry evidence directly increments global_jspace_causal_credit.

go_tracks.track_a: Prevents the variable-grid executable fixture from emitting evidence stronger than its actual execution surface.
go_tracks.track_b: Adds a reusable typed fail-closed interconnect evidence boundary for workspace reentry packets.
go_tracks.track_c: Separates observable reentry packet/use evidence from model-specific Global J-Space causal promotion.

next_exact_gate: Run a real admitted zero-cost observable-interface matched-control reentry measurement with exact request/result/workspace identities and off-target regression; keep UNKNOWN if that surface is unavailable.
